limitations: Search engines returned substantial irrelevant material, stale coverage, and false positives; results are not a systematic census.

provisional_leads.location: Nationwide Algeria; source specifically reports a Blida administrative court order
provisional_leads.actors: National Autonomous Union of Public Health Anesthesia and Resuscitation Medical Assistants (SNAMARSP)
provisional_leads.event_date_or_window: 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-03 (announced strike window); the June 2 report says a court ordered suspension

source.title: Grève des auxiliaires médicaux en anesthésie et réanimation : une ordonnance en référé ordonne sa suspension
source.accessed_utc: 2026-10-11; within the bracketed search/open window above
source.short_excerpt: ordonnant la suspension de la grève annoncée
source.provenance: Radio Algérienne; page attributes underlying statement to the Ministry of Health and identifies APS as source (page lines 45–56 in browser extraction).

provisional_leads.assessment: Strong evidence that a national strike had been announced and that a suspension order was reported on June 2. No source in this pass verifies that workers actually struck or that a street demonstration occurred. Keep as a follow-up lead, not a confirmed protest event.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: The report is based on the ministry statement; no union statement, court document, or independent report of actual worker participation was located in this pass.

provisional_leads.type: false call rumor / excluded event lead
provisional_leads.location: Algiers (UGTA representative quoted at University of Algiers 3); alleged proposed scope was national
provisional_leads.event_date_or_window: 2026-04-20 was the purported start date in the forged call; UGTA denied the call on 2026-04-18/19

source.title: Grève nationale le 20 avril ? L’UGTA met fin à la rumeur
source.accessed_utc: 2026-10-11; within the bracketed search/open window above
source.short_excerpt: l’UGTA ... a rejeté ... l’authenticité du document en circulation
source.provenance: Algérie 360; directly opened and read, publication time shown on page at lines 26–45.

provisional_leads.assessment: Exclude as a protest-event record: the report says UGTA rejected the purported national strike call as fabricated. It documents circulation of a rumor and an organizational denial, not a strike occurrence.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: The article reports UGTA's account; no independent investigation into the anonymous document was conducted.

provisional_leads.type: advocacy statement / possible planned mobilization; occurrence unverified
provisional_leads.actors: Algerian Party for Democracy and Socialism (PADS)
provisional_leads.event_date_or_window: 2026-05-01 (statement calls for May Day to be a day of worker mobilization; it does not document an event held)

source.title: PADS, Algeria, May 1st, 2026 – A Day of Mobilization and Struggle of Workers Against Capitalist Exploitation and Imperialist Wars
source.accessed_utc: 2026-10-11; within the bracketed search/open window above
source.short_excerpt: Les travailleurs algériens sont appelés à faire du 1er Mai une journée de mobilisation
source.provenance: Solidnet republishes a PADS statement; page metadata dated May 4 and statement text dated April 30 (opened page lines 46–56, 71–85).

provisional_leads.assessment: Retain only as a low-specificity call/advocacy lead. It does not provide time, place, participating group beyond the party's appeal, attendance, or confirmation that a mobilization took place.
provisional_leads.uncertainty: Party statement is advocacy and not independent event reporting; no corroborating event report found in this pass.

no_findings_by_month.2026-04: This first discovery pass found no verified protest event in Algeria from April beyond the denied April 20 strike rumor. This is a search outcome, not evidence that no other action occurred.
no_findings_by_month.2026-05: This first discovery pass found a general May Day mobilization appeal and an official commemoration snippet, but no specific, verified contemporary protest event. Search outcome only; absence is not established.
no_findings_by_month.2026-06: This first pass found a planned health-sector strike suspended by a court order, but no verified account of strike occurrence or street demonstration. Search outcome only; absence is not established.

failures_and_follow_up: Algérie Presse Service English page for the May 2 UGTA item opened to a maintenance shell; the search snippet is retained with that limitation.
Le Monde June 8 result was identified by inherited coordinator handoff as subscriber-only; no bypass attempted and no event extracted from it.
For the June health strike, follow up with SNAMARSP union communications or independent reporting from June 2–3 to determine whether any action occurred despite the reported court suspension.
